goal: Wave 2 build: Carry and re-verify contract at fire and step; Broker AcquireGrant consults org-core site policy; Space browser entitlement as boolean floor

slices.title: Carry and re-verify contract at fire and step
slices.summary: Carries the contract JSON, digest and expiry from the workflow template through orchestrator-core, session-core and user-core decisions into execution-core, which recomputes the digest and refuses expired or forged contracts at fire and at each scheduled step. Claims stay at decision version v2 with two serde-default fields, under a mandatory rollout order.
slices.flag: EXECUTION_CORE_SCHEDULED_CONTRACT_REQUIRED (default false; only controls a run created with a contract whose context lacks one)

decisions_defaults.DEC-16: (b): the 2026-09-28 ruling is amended, not reversed: v1 still takes no effect, read tools run. Control signs `contract_digest`, `contract_expires_at`, class ceiling `read`; capability-core verifies; expiry required (default 30 d, max 90 d `SCHEDULE_CONTRACT_MA

slices.title: Broker AcquireGrant consults org-core site policy
slices.summary: Adds a fail-closed org-core resolve client to the browser broker (2 s timeout, positive cache up to 30 s, refuse when org-core is down) and makes AcquireGrant for run grants intersect requested domains with what the policy allows at that level; an empty result is PermissionDenied with denied_domains, capped at the start host plus 8, with read_only and ttl_seconds honoured up to 30 min. browser.proto gains the 4.3 tags (request space_id 10, read_only 11, ttl_seconds 12; response read_only 10, denied_domains 11; validate read_only 10, subject to QRY renumbering).
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/go/services/browser-broker" && go test ./... && go vet ./...
slices.flag: BROWSER_BROKER_SITE_POLICY=off|shadow|enforce, default off until S10; an unknown value is treated as enforce (K3-26); BROWSER_GRANT_MAX_TTL default 30 min
risk: cross-branch: the Quarry-side grant issuance endpoint and Quarry-to-broker identity are built on local branch quarryv2, not on model-plane; build against the contract with a stub and leave the live proof to the lead after quarryv2 merges

decisions_defaults.DEC-19: (d) layered: Control org-core is policy of record, broker enforces at mint from the verified principal, Quarry stays final enforcer. One grant per (run, level), fence = start host + at most 8 hosts; open web minus block list default; private/loopback never gra
decisions_defaults.DEC-20: Server-bound: model sees `browser.open{url}`, `.observe{}`, `.act{action}`, `.close{}`. New cause `browser_site_consent`. Grant minted under the user's delegated BrowserBroker bearer, never from request JSON. Grant store decided by QRY; WS21 works on in-memory
